name: 86d (inside Coin-Op)
notes: Photos 1 and 2 are the same 86d menu (photo 2 repeats the 4 Press Start items with minor wording differences); merged using photo 1, which is the more complete version with Extra Life wings, Bonus Round, Fries Loading and Level Up sections. Photo 3 is an 86d Happy Hour flyer with discounted prices for some of the same dishes (2 Chashu Tacos $7, Viet Caesar Salad $6, Pretzels $7, Small Fry $4, Nachos $6) so it was not added as separate dishes. Photo 4 shows a 'Common Table' menu board at 3914 30th St, a different business/address than this restaurant (3926 30th St), so it was skipped entirely as not belonging to this listing.
